summary: Enhance your skills with our Vendor and Supplier Contract Management Training Course. Learn best practices to streamline contracts and boost efficiency.
lede: Supplier relationship management training helps professionals overseeing vendors and supplier contracts control delivery, cost and accountability. It covers defining verifiable deliverables and acceptance criteria, setting performance measures, matching invoices to milestones, and managing changes, renewals and disputes with clear documentation from onboarding through close-out.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically designed for professionals who regularly manage vendors, supplier contracts, and third-party performance. If your role involves any aspect of contract management, this course is for you.
modules: Principles of Vendor and Supplier Contract Management
Defining Scope, Deliverables, and Acceptance Criteria
Contract Close-Out and Supplier Performance Review
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have basic knowledge of procurement and contract fundamentals. Prior experience in vendor or contract management roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
